name: 43677-sharegpt-8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8 -- an FP8 BLOCK-quantised chat checkpoint, 9.45 GB on disk, ungated.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: dense decoder (Qwen3ForCausalLM), 36 layers, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads (GQA 4:1), head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 12288, vocab 151936, window 40960; the Linears are FP8 e4m3 in 128x128 blocks with dynamic activation scales, bf16 everywhere else.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 10%, bounded at 530 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. No cooldown -- a closed loop with a fixed request count drains rather than tapers.
workload: `configs/data/sharegpt-qwen3-out300.jsonl` -- 530 single-turn ShareGPT prompts, greedy, posted as plain completions. Prompt lengths are min 4 / mean 217.6 / max 975 tokens, ~115.3k prompt tokens over the file; the file is the whole request bound, so the loader never cycles. OUTPUT LENGTH IS FIXED AT 300 FOR EVERY REQUEST, so the run emits exactly 159,000 output tokens and the decode work is fixed rather than data-dependent. No prompt shares a prefix with another and prefix caching is off.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant on an 8-billion-parameter FP8 model, serving eight concurrent users fixed 300-token replies from one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 8
max-num-batched-tokens: 512
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.95
kv-cache-dtype: fp8
enable-prefix-caching: false
enable-flashinfer-autotune: false

# HAZARD: `compilation-config` MUST stay on ONE line of JSON with its double quotes. The config
# reader is line-based and drops an indented block outright, which starts the engine with no
# compilation-config at all -- at rc=0 and with no error. An unquoted YAML flow mapping fails
# `json.loads` and degrades to a bare string, which pydantic then rejects.
compilation-config: {"mode": 0, "cudagraph_mode": "FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}

max-model-len: 40960
